name: Data Converter
description: Convert data in one DBX workbench panel: JSON / YAML / XML / Properties, batch text to SQL (IN / NOT IN / INSERT), .xlsx / .csv / .tsv to JSON, and Image ⇄ Base64. A Code Gen page turns a JSON sample or a CREATE TABLE into TypeScript / Go / Java / Python models. Pure frontend, no backend, works offline.
releaseNotes: 0.1.5 (update): a new Image ↔ Base64 page (DataURI / raw Base64 / CSS / HTML / Markdown output, bare Base64 decoded straight back into a picture, SVG and pasted SVG source included) and a new Code Gen page. Code Gen turns a JSON sample or a CREATE TABLE into TypeScript interfaces, Go structs, Java POJOs or Python dataclasses, splitting nested structures into their own types, camel-casing column names and carrying comments into the code. All six pages are translated into every one of the 14 supported languages, and the panel stays bounded: chunked work, hard limits on size and depth, no network and no eval.
